title: Policy Engine: Declarative Constraint Auditor and Validator for Region/Tier/Fallback Routing
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Refactor the routing policy engine to introduce a standalone declarative constraint auditor and schema validator that statically verifies region selection rules, tier routing, and fallback model variant policies. The validator must detect unreachable branches, incompatible model-variant fallbacks, and tier-constraint violations; emit actionable error messages and remediation hints; provide a CLI/lint mode and a CI hook; and be backward-compatible with current DSL-based config files with a migration helper.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical parser produces typed AST for existing DSL and new JSON/YAML policy manifests
Validator flags invalid region selectors (unknown region codes, mutually-exclusive constraints) with clear remediation text
Tier routing rules rejected when constraints violate SLA or reserved capacity annotations
Fallback model variants validated against compatibility matrix (architecture, quantization, sequence-length) and a fallback path is suggested when incompatible
Linter/CI integration added to repo that fails builds for non-conformant policies
Console surface shows validation errors inline when uploading a policy and links to remediation docs
Existing policies migrate with automated tool or are marked with precise migration errors; no silent behavioral changes in production routing

implementation_plan: Phase 1 - Parser & Typed AST: Extend parser to produce typed nodes for region, tier, and fallback clauses. Add unit tests for syntactic edge cases.
Phase 2 - Static Constraint Checks: Implement rule linter to detect mutually-exclusive selectors, unreachable branches, and reserved-capacity conflicts. Emit structured errors with remediation steps.
Phase 3 - Compatibility & Runtime Mapping: Validate fallback variants against compatibility matrix and runtime kernel capability profiles. Stub an emergency fallback suggestion engine.
Phase 4 - Tooling & Rollout: Add CLI lint mode, CI hook, and Console inline validation UI. Run in warn-only mode for first two cycles before blocking deploys.
Phase 5 - Migration & Metrics: Provide migration helper, populate telemetry for failing classes, and monitor customer-facing errors during enforcement canary.
Estimated iterations: 3 sprints + 2-week rollout window for enforcement
